summary: The accepted disclosure correction now matches through step 573. The remaining step-574 score-list message is emitted correctly by topten, then erased when the async JavaScript path returns from the C NORETURN offer_real_amulet branch and continues into dosacrifice’s unreachable nothing_happens tail. Return from dosacrifice after the terminal state is set.

source.branch: On a high altar, dosacrifice calls offer_real_amulet for a real Amulet. For the wrong-god route, offer_real_amulet calls done(ESCAPED), so C never reaches dosacrifice’s later fake-Amulet, corpse, or nothing_happens branches. The browser port models done by setting gameover and returning; dosacrifice must stop after the awaited helper when gameover is set.
callers: cmd.c:act_on_act dispatches dosacrifice; js/cmd.js dispatches the same queued handler.
pray.c:dosacrifice calls offer_real_amulet; js/pray.js:dosacrifice awaits it.
dependencies: end.c:done(ESCAPED) enters end.c:really_done, declared NORETURN; js/end.js:really_done sets program_state.gameover and returns to its async caller.
The already accepted end.c:disclose correction accounts for the previous step-571 mismatch and remains preserved below.

selectionReason: Selected the same v79 session after acceptance released its reservation. The corrected step-571 conduct prompt now matches; the promoted queue identifies one residual screen at step 574, and bounded runtime instrumentation traces it to a post-finalization continuation in pray.c:dosacrifice.
evidence: Official v79 evaluation reports 573/575 screens, 574/575 cursors, and 20693/20693 RNG calls, with no exception. Its source pointer is end.c:disclose670-680 -> insight.c:count_achievements.

JavaScript js/end.js currently passes the fixed "Do you want to see your conduct?" literal; js/insight.js already exports count_achievements and scripts/insight.test.mjs pins its zero-terminated count behavior.
Prep’s accepted crosswalk excludes the prior v75 unopened-box disclosure issue: it was an ordinary quit with no achievement and did not enter the nonzero-count conditional.

After the change, a full comparison against the unchanged official C recording matches 574/575 screens, 575/575 cursors, and 20693/20693 RNG calls. The first remaining difference is at zero-based step 574, after disclose has completed: C prints “Since you were in wizard mode, the score list will not be checked.” while JS retains the prior map screen. The source lead is end.c:really_done -> topten.c:topten; this later output is outside the claimed end.c:disclose scope.

The accepted JS source js/end.js:really_done completes toptenDisplay before returning with gameover true. A bounded private JS replay instrumented js/topten.js and js/end.js: it reached the wizard topten branch with wizard=true and panicking=false, and serialized “Since you were in wizard mode, the score list will not be checked.” immediately after topten returned.

The same replay instrumented a private copy of js/game_display.js. The first write after the score-list output came from display.js:_buildScreenOutput -> tty_message.js:ttyPlineCore -> pray.js:dosacrifice, where the source’s nothing_happens tail rewrote the screen. The full input replay retained 20693 RNG calls, 575 screens, and 575 cursors.
The prior accepted diagnosis remains intact in previousDiagnosis and its earlier evidence entries remain unchanged; this follow-up isolates the later terminal-return control-flow mismatch.

source.branch: When should_query_disclose_option('c') requests a prompt, end.c:disclose counts achievements and appends " and achievements" only for a nonzero result. JavaScript now calls the existing count_achievements helper in the same branch and passes the conditional query to yn_function. The admitted Astral ending has ACH_UWIN, so it exercises the suffix branch.

dependencies: insight.c:count_achievements is already implemented by js/insight.js:count_achievements and tested for zero-terminated achievement lists in scripts/insight.test.mjs; disclose must use its return value to match C.
